Veteran Actor Recalls Rajesh Khanna's Alleged Arrogance and Downfall

Veteran actor Tej Sapru has recalled an incident where she claims Rajesh Khanna abused her and exhibited arrogance. Sapru stated that she was very upset by the encounter.
